name: ftai-plugins-official
description: Curated directory of high-quality plugins, MCP servers, and Skills for FtAi Desktop and Claude Code developers.

plugins.name: notion
plugins.description: Notion workspace integration: search pages, create and update documents, manage databases, and access your team knowledge base.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Official GitHub integration for repository management: create issues, manage PRs, review code, search repositories and commits.

plugins.name: google-drive
plugins.description: Google Drive integration: search cloud files, read Google Docs/Sheets, list directories, and manage drive assets directly from AI.

plugins.name: gitlab
plugins.description: GitLab DevOps platform integration: manage repositories, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, issues, and wikis for self-hosted and cloud GitLab.

plugins.name: linear
plugins.description: Linear project management integration: create issues, track sprint cycles, update project statuses, and search team workspaces.

plugins.name: figma
plugins.description: Figma design system integration: inspect design files, extract component trees, read design tokens, and convert designs into clean UI code.

plugins.name: postgres
plugins.description: PostgreSQL database management: inspect schemas, execute safe analytical queries, analyze table indices, and generate migrations.

plugins.name: redis
plugins.description: Redis memory store integration: inspect cache keys, monitor memory usage, debug pub/sub channels, and inspect TTL / data structures.

plugins.name: docker
plugins.description: Docker container & compose management: inspect running containers, view logs, manage images, and generate Dockerfiles / Compose configurations.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: End-to-end browser automation & testing: interact with live web apps, take screenshots, assert DOM elements, and simulate user workflows.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Up-to-date documentation search for hundreds of frameworks and libraries (React, Vue, Tailwind, Next.js, Rust, Python, Go, etc.).

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Comprehensive multi-perspective code reviewer: reviews git diffs for correctness, security, architectural consistency, and test coverage.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Craft distinctive, production-ready frontend interfaces with top-tier typography, cohesive color token systems, and accessible components.

plugins.name: tavily
plugins.description: AI-native real-time web search and content extraction engine optimized for LLMs and multi-step research tasks.

plugins.name: exa
plugins.description: Neural web search, deep academic and technical research, company profiles, and content extraction via Exa AI API.

plugins.name: supabase
plugins.description: Supabase BaaS integration: query PostgreSQL, manage database schema, view storage buckets, and test Edge Functions.

plugins.name: slack
plugins.description: Slack workspace communication: search message threads, retrieve channel history, and post notifications from dev workflows.

plugins.name: vercel
plugins.description: Vercel frontend cloud integration: inspect deployments, review build logs, manage domain routes, and monitor serverless functions.

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Sentry error & performance monitoring: query crash reports, analyze stack traces, and correlate production exceptions with source code.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Advanced software engineering methodology toolkit: Systematic Debugging, Red-Green TDD, Brainstorming, and Subagent Delegation.
